uncertain_pairs.why: Both are Soriano pre-fight interviews from the same week and could come from one media session, but the quotes and subjects are entirely different.
112.ua explicitly cites Sport.ua, so it may be a rewrite of the Sport.ua preview, but the Sport.ua body text is unreadable.
Same official weigh-in event, but MMA Fighting's piece is about the whole card and Parnasse, with Donchenko as one line.
Ceremonial weigh-in faceoff and official weigh-in are the same day and same fighters, though technically separate events.
A fight-day live page from Sport.ua likely ended up reporting the same result as MMA Fighting, but the captured body shows no result.
